description: Root scaffolding, shared packages, and event bus. Creates the monorepo skeleton that all subsequent FEATs build on: root package.json with npm workspaces, base tsconfig.json, .env.example, docker-compose.yml, README.md, packages/shared (types+schemas+utils), and services/shared-events (in-memory EventEmitter bus).
steps: 1. Create root package.json with 'workspaces': ['apps/*','services/*','packages/*'], scripts: { 'dev': 'concurrently (each service and web)', 'build': 'npm run build --workspaces', 'lint': 'tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json' }, devDependencies: concurrently, typescript, @types/node.
2. Create root tsconfig.json with strict:true, target:ES2022, module:Node16, moduleResolution:Node16, paths for @terno/shared and @terno/shared-events.

3. Create .env.example at root with: MONGODB_URI, JWT_ACCESS_SECRET, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET, FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:3000, API_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:4000, AUTH_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4001, USER_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4002, TRIP_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4003, BOOKING_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4004, PAYMENT_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4005, NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4006, NODE_ENV=development.

5. Create docker-compose.yml with services: mongodb (mongo:7 image, port 27017, named volume), and placeholders for each app service (commented out — developer runs services directly during development).
6. Create packages/shared/package.json: name '@terno/shared', type 'module', main './dist/index.js', types './dist/index.d.ts', scripts build/dev. Add dependencies: zod.

8. Create packages/shared/src/types/index.ts — export all domain interfaces: IUser, ITrip, ITripItineraryDay, IBooking, IPayment, INotification, ApiResponse<T>, PaginatedResponse<T>. ITrip includes: _id, title, destination, country, description, category (enum: Adventure|Beach|Cultural|Wildlife|City|Mountain|Budget), duration (days), maxGroupSize, pricePerPerson, discountPrice?, images[], itinerary (ITripItineraryDay[]), inclusions[], exclusions[], accommodationType, difficulty (Easy|Moderate|Challenging), startDates (Date[]), availableSeats, ratingsAverage, ratingsQuantity, cancellationPolicy, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt. IBooking includes: _id, bookingRef, userId, tripId (populated ITrip), departureDate, travellers (ITraveller[]), totalAmount, status (Pending|Confirmed|Cancelled|Refunded), paymentStatus (Pending|Paid|Refunded|Failed), contactEmail, contactPhone, specialRequests?, createdAt. IPayment includes order details, provider (mock), status. INotification includes: _id, userId, title, message, type (booking|payment|system), read, createdAt.

9. Create packages/shared/src/schemas/index.ts — export Zod schemas: registerSchema (name, email, password min 8), loginSchema, updateProfileSchema, searchTripsSchema (query, category, minPrice, maxPrice, duration, page, limit), createBookingSchema (tripId, departureDate, travellers, contactEmail, contactPhone, specialRequests), paymentSchema, and all response envelope schemas.

10. Create packages/shared/src/utils/index.ts — export: createApiResponse<T>(data, message), createPaginatedResponse<T>, formatCurrency(amount, currency='INR'), generateBookingRef() (returns TERNO-XXXXXX), sleep(ms), pick(obj, keys[]).
11. Create packages/shared/src/index.ts — re-export everything from types, schemas, utils.

14. Create services/shared-events/src/EventBus.ts — singleton class wrapping Node.js EventEmitter. Methods: emit(event: string, payload: unknown): void, on(event: string, handler: Function): void, off(event: string, handler: Function): void. Export a single instance 'eventBus'. Document clearly that this is in-memory only and not durable.

15. Create services/shared-events/src/events.ts — export typed event name constants and payload interfaces: BOOKING_CREATED (BookingCreatedPayload: bookingId, userId, tripId, totalAmount, contactEmail), PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED (PaymentSucceededPayload: bookingId, paymentId, amount), PAYMENT_FAILED (PaymentFailedPayload: bookingId, reason), BOOKING_CONFIRMED (BookingConfirmedPayload: bookingId, userId), BOOKING_CANCELLED (BookingCancelledPayload: bookingId, userId).
16. Create services/shared-events/src/index.ts — re-export EventBus and events.

17. Create README.md at root with: project overview, port map table, prerequisites (Node 20+, MongoDB URI), setup steps (copy .env.example, fill MONGODB_URI, npm install, npm run dev), service descriptions, and a note about the mock payment provider.
acceptance_criteria: packages/shared builds: 'cd packages/shared && npm run build' produces dist/index.js and dist/index.d.ts
services/shared-events builds: 'cd services/shared-events && npm run build' produces dist/
@terno/shared exports ITrip, IBooking, IUser, INotification, IPayment, ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse, all Zod schemas, and all utils
@terno/shared-events exports eventBus singleton and event name constants
.env.example exists with all required variable placeholders
verification: Confirm dist/ directories exist in both packages
findings: 1. Used typescript@5.4.5, @types/node@20.12.12, concurrently@8.2.2, zod@3.23.8 (all pinned exact minor). 2. Root tsconfig.json uses module:Node16/moduleResolution:Node16 for ESM compatibility — each sub-package tsconfig clears the 'paths' key to avoid TypeScript complaining about missing path mappings during individual builds. 3. packages/shared tsconfig sets paths:{} to override root paths (which point to src/) so tsc resolves zod from node_modules correctly during the isolated build. 4. services/shared-events has no external runtime dependencies — only TypeScript dev deps. 5. Both packages build cleanly to dist/ with .d.ts declarations and source maps.
